reviews.snippet:
Title: A Deeply Disappointing Experience at Cloudnine Jayanagar (Except for Dr. Aruna Muralidhar)

We recently shifted to Cloudnine Hospital, Jayanagar for our maternity care after initially being treated at Motherhood by Dr. Sangeeta Gomes, whose approach made us anxious with repeated fearmongering about preterm delivery and excessive prescriptions, which seemed driven more by commissions than care.

At Cloudnine, we were fortunate to be under the care of Dr. Aruna Muralidhar, who was a beacon of hope. She was compassionate, informative, and supportive throughout the pregnancy journey. We’re truly grateful to her.

However, our delivery experience was deeply disappointing due to the mismanagement and unprofessionalism of the hospital's administrative staff. From CRE Roopa, Operations Manager Yashoda, Billing Manager Akshata, Lavanya, and others, we encountered:

Confusing and inconsistent billing – charges were levied for services we never used, some were doubly billed, and everyone gave conflicting information.

Aggressive and insensitive behavior – when I raised concerns about the inflated bills (especially as I didn’t have insurance), I was met with shouting and rude arguments, particularly from Yashoda, who argued with me for over 30 minutes.

Artificial discounts – prices were jacked up unnecessarily and token discounts were presented as favors, making the entire system feel exploitative.

It’s unfortunate that a hospital that promises compassionate maternity care focuses more on profits than patients. Except for Dr. Aruna Muralidhar, the rest of our experience felt like a commercial trap.

Hospitals should prioritize the emotional and physical well-being of new parents, not add stress through financial and administrative harassment. I sincerely hope Cloudnine re-evaluates its practices.

reviews.snippet:
My experience with Cloudnine Jayanagar was worse that I can’t even recall those horrific days of my delivery and recovery time.

Am little late to write this review but it would be my pleasure if I can save someone from such horror by not choosing this hospital for special moments of their lives.

The doctor I consulted was Dr. Brunda Channappa. Who is just rude with her patients and an over hyped doctor.

- I was contracted with deadly infectious bacteria called Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) from their hospital during my delivery.
- I was admitted early to induce labor due to gestational diabetes condition and Brunda didn’t show up till next morning while I was being induced by some young doctors whom I never consulted before. (While we chose a doctor, we put our trust in them for a smooth delivery right? And how does it feel when that doctor didn’t even show up while you are in labor)
- I was hurried for an emergency c section as the baby’s heartbeat was dropping and by Allah’s grace “my angel arrived fine”
- Thankfully, Brunda showed up for cesarean atleast ( I believe that I carried MRSA infection from their operating room)
- Their canteen services suck, as they never responded to our calls
- Because of the infection, my stitches started leaking puss with high fever right after I was delivered without even properly checking.
- I was not even prescribed with antibiotics during discharge which was atmost need for stitches to heal.
- I was again admitted back to hospital as my stitches looked worse, again here Brunda was not available and was referred to another rude doctor named Meenakshi.
- The pain was unbearable that I literally thought that am going to die
- With all the heavy dose antibiotics, it took 2 months for me to recover from MRSA.
- I couldn’t enjoy the most beautiful moments of my life due to medical negligence.
-Most unhygienic hospital I have ever been and they only care about money.
-Brunda doesn’t even have manners on how to treat parents of her patients, she made offensive comments on my mother during her rounds. Arrogancy doesn’t suit doctors😡

Worst Doctor and terrible hospital!!!!!!!!

Note: Do not believe 5 star reviews on their website page as they compel their visitors to review right infront of them. In our case, the receptionist herself took my husband’s mobile and rated 5 star during our appointment visit.

-

I got admitted to this hospital because many of my relatives suggested this, thinking about what everyone said, i got admitted.
From beginning they said, you'll have normal delivery, On the delivery date in morning also they said "normal delivery is going to happen, the same they said even in the evening after  taking a scanning which showed that I didn't have any trouble. Just one hour later, they said, it has become too complicated, we have to do c-section, Stating the reason that the food pipe has twisted three rounds around baby's neck, and the thing is that they didn't even take me for scanning, i wonder how will they get to know regarding internal organ system without a scan.
My delivery was delayed saying that they don't have any rooms, and made me to stay in emergency room for 10 hours+ and If i had to go to washroom, i had to go for long distance as emergency ward doesn't have bathroom.
Next the worst part - billing, we booked for normal luxury room which includes all the things which they've mentioned in the list, and for c-section its 1,00,000. Though i had c-section, they charged me 1,25,000+... stating some random bills, baby's tests and all.... they had included all those within 1 lakh, now everything changed. Some nurses are very very rude, rough handling of baby while changing diaper and while taking to bath.
Worst hospital ever, will never ever recommend this hospital to anyone.

As many have stated, it's overpriced which is not at all worth, over hyped which is too much.
Utterly disappointed.

reviews.snippet:
I delivered last week at Cloudnine jayanagar branch which is supposed to be a specialty hospital for maternity. I am unsure about other branches but my time at the jayanagar branch was just a very sad experience. I got the topmost package that they had to offer but the treatment was no way near to what they market.
For starters they put PPE kit charges on our bill when not even one person was wearing a ppe kit. We had to force them to remove the charges. And pertaining to my delivery  I was uninformed about the pain relieving options and at what stage I could take it. There was no professionalism maintained inside the delivery room, the staff is busy chatting away while the patient is lying there in contraction pain the least they could do is maintain some silence. I was literally begging them to provide an extra fan for almost half an hour lying on the Delivery room bed, but they were least bothered to attend to the patients concern first. They dint bother to inform us that we need a rtpcr negative report for the attender to accompany inside the delivery room and denied access to my husband  to accompany. I had to literally beg the consulting doctor in the peak of my contractions to let my husband in to which she agreed. Overall pls consider twice before entering this hospital. I really wanted my first childs birth to be an amazing experience but it was rather a depressing one.

reviews.snippet:
The worst possible hospital for OPD. They have absolutely no regard or respect for the inpatient's time. They make you wait endlessly and give you no update. They over book appointments and the hospital ends up seeming like a fish market. Be prepared to waste at least half a day here just waiting.

The OPD dept seems like a dangerous place where infants can easily catch an infection.

The hospital charges an exorbitant fee for consultation.

Be prepared for serious damage to your wallet.

The doctors are good, so if possible have a chat with the doctors and visit them at their own clinic to save some money.

Lastly, the billing desk for hospital admission for deliveries does not accept payment by CREDIT CARDS, so if the delivery charge comes to 1.5 - 2 Lakhs, then don't forget to keep cash in hand. Such a big hospital and they don't take cards, wow...

reviews.snippet: This is a horrible place for new mothers. Totally commercialised. My gynec in this hospital was so rude that he would not even suggest abt diet during pregnancy. He answers saying eat what basically humans eat. As a new mother u would have lot of questions n anxiety. They would not bother to answer them. My nightmare started during my 9th mth. Since i had put on weight due to constant rubbing bw my thighs n private parts there were rashes. The doc suspects that i have std. That hospital have inexperienced skin specialists as well. When i showed it to skin specialist her immediate reaction was i dont see anything unusual. Then she changed her mind and says since doc is saying there must be something suspicious. She calls doc in front of me and confirms that i have std without second thought. As a mother i felt devastated. She asks me to get c section so that baby is safe and she advices c section is painless when compared to normal. They are so cheap. I went to st. Johns hospital hod for 2nd opinion. He said its jst a rash and it should not be the reason for c section. The rash got healed within 2 days. The doc did not even explain the diff bw urinal discharge and water breakage. I had to call another doc for the answer. At the time of delivery i had water discharge at 4 am. I called the doc at 6 am. He gave appointment at 7 but comes at 8am. By that time there was blood along with water discharge. The doc scolds me saying that it is not an emergency. After checking internally he asks me to get admitted and c section will b 12pm. They r irresponsible ppl. They jst want money( quick) . want us to vacate the hospital quickly so that they can have new admission. At the time of birth my son had jaundice. They sent us home. After 2 days f going back they ask us to admit the child for phototherapy. My greviences went on and on. I cannot pen everything here. My overall experience here was horrible. Even today if i think of 2nd child it gives me chills. Thanks to that doc. I have not mentioned his name since it is not ethics.

The only difference between any government hospital and cloud nine jayanaJay hospital is the hefty bill. The service is worse than any government hospital. Below are some example.
1. Admitted in the hospital at 6AM, delivered the baby at 1.40 pm. The patient  was very hungry, so ordered the lunch for patient ( part of package) at 2 PM, dispite of multiple followup, received food at 4.30 PM without any reason
2. Skipped the BATH to patient after delivery saying there is a delay in food and without lunch they can't give bath.
3. Shifted to the ward without providing the Maternity pad, resulted in blood all over the dress and room.
4. Requested multiple times to get the The basic consumable like wet wipes, baby pad even though we are paying for that.

The condition of the car after using the paid parking of cloud nine was so bad. We can't make out it is our car from the far.

So think before admitting.
